6. Add relation predicate synonym mapping -> canonical allowlist keys.

10. Skill tags/categories normalization: casefold + trim punctuation + dedupe.
11. Skill taxonomy evidence: ensure tag/category edges prefer real mention spans when available.
12. Add docs: how KG is stored (Postgres tables + Milvus vectors) + how to export.
13. Add/verify API endpoint docstrings for KG extraction/search/graph export (OpenAPI clarity).
14. RAG KG query expansion: exclude Skill-like entity types by default; add config switch.
15. Add unit test for KG query expansion type filtering.
16. Run make openapi-check and commit generated web/types/openapi.ts if changed.
17. Run make api-check and fix any contract mismatches.
18. Run ruff + pytest; fix regressions.
19. Update CHANGELOG.md for release and remove stale Unreleased bullets if needed.
20. Merge to main, git pull --rebase, bd sync, git push, and create+push tag v0.2.

- Or make `web/eslint.config.js` compatible with legacy `eslint-config-next` by using FlatCompat / conditional conversion.
notes:
Root cause: web devDependencies used ESLint 10, but eslint-plugin-react 7.37.5 only supports ESLint < 10, which crashed linting.

title: governance: persist doc-level quality + char stats for audit (no parsed markdown)
description:
Problem
- Governance audit char reduction distribution currently depends on persist_parsed_content. This can be expensive and privacy-sensitive.
- Governance quality metrics (density/heading_ratio/etc) are computed per-item but not persisted at the document level for dataset reporting/tuning.

Goal
- Persist lightweight, privacy-safe doc-level governance metrics (char counts + quality metrics) in document.doc_metadata so dataset reports and report center can visualize governance effects without storing markdown content.

Acceptance Criteria
- Ingestion pipeline records governance char stats (original_chars/cleaned_chars/reduction_pct) for governance-enabled runs.
- Ingestion pipeline records governance quality metrics (density, heading_ratio, etc) at document level.
- Dataset report governance_audit uses these stats as fallback when parsed_content_persisted is missing.
- Frontend report center shows char reduction distribution even when persist_parsed_content is off (via fallback stats), and adds basic governance quality distribution (density + heading_ratio).
- Tests cover aggregation + metadata recording.
